about: A checklist for your dashboard. Add tasks, tick them off when they are done and delete the ones you no longer need. Completed tasks fold away so the list stays short.
highlights: Lives in the dashboard carousel, next to the calendar and Hydration
Your tasks are kept in one small file and survive restarts
Completed tasks fold away and can be shown again
author: iMacnucintosh

changes: Needs Sylphrena 0.3: the plural of the pending tasks is translated
Lists the data it leaves behind, so removing it can delete it too
First release in the hub (it used to ship with the shell)
